shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Shadow: none by default; the sticky cart-bar variant uses `rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 0 -2px 12px` above it

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#E8E8E8`): 1pt separators between menu items and list rows.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Dark Surface 2 (`#2C2C2E`): Higher elevation, chip default.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The accent system is a single green. Uber Eats Green (`#06C167`) — the brand's fresh, slightly cool green — owns every primary action: the "Add to cart" button, the sticky cart bar, active filter pills, the "Track order" CTA, and selected states. Near-black (`#000000`) carries titles and the secondary "Schedule" / outline actions, and a mid gray (`#6B6B6B`) handles metadata (ratings, ETA, fees). There is no second brand hue — against full-color food photography and a white canvas, the green reads instantly as "order." A dark mode is fully supported (inverting to a near-black canvas) but the default and primary experience is light.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use a pure white canvas ({#FFFFFF}) by default — photo-first, gallery-like whitespace (dark mode inverts neutrals only)。
建议：Reserve Uber Eats Green ({#06C167}) for primary actions and selected states — cart bar, Add, Track, active pill。
建议：Keep the same green ({#06C167}) in dark mode — only neutrals invert。
建议：Let restaurant cards sit borderless and shadowless on white — the food photo provides the framing。
建议：Keep ratings monochrome (near-black star) — quiet merchandising so green = action stands out。
dont: 避免：default to a dark canvas — the brand is bright and photo-first (dark mode is a supported alternate, not the default)。
避免：add a second accent hue — the single green is the entire action language。
避免：color the rating star yellow — Uber Eats keeps it monochrome and quiet。
避免：put borders/shadows on restaurant cards — they sit flat on white; the photo frames itself。
避免：use thin or black weights — Uber Move here is 400 / 500 / 700 only。
